svg.title: Nice to Monaco running elevation profile
svg.desc: About 25.3 kilometres one way. A mostly flat opening, climbs around kilometres 7 to 8, 11 to 12 and 18 to 21, and a descent back towards the coastal path. Highest supplied elevation is about 93 metres above sea level.

g.text: NICE TO MONACO / THE COASTAL RUN
The climbs come after the promenade
